tn.cat: Best Featured Actress in a Play

cn.t: Critics praise this Lorraine Hansberry revival, with Oscar Isaac and Rachel Brosnahan earning particular acclaim for bringing depth to the playwright's ambitious exploration of 1960s bohemian idealism and social issues in Greenwich Village.
